mapper.insert:
SELECT fn_make_date_code('ATTENDANCE') FROM dual
INSERT INTO tb_attendance ( company_code, atten_code, user_id, work_date, attend_type, in_time, out_time, over_work_time, night_work_time, holiday_work_time, total_work_time, remark, created_by, create_date, work_place_type ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{attenCode}, #{userId}, TRUNC(SYSDATE), #{attendType}, -- h1 / h2 SYSDATE, -- 출근시간 NULL, -- 퇴근 전이므로 null 0, -- 연장 0 0, -- 야간 0 0, -- 휴일 0 0, -- 총 근무시간 0 (퇴근 시 계산) #{remark}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, #{workPlaceType} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_attendance SET out_time = SYSDATE, over_work_time = #{overWorkTime}, night_work_time = #{nightWorkTime}, total_work_time = #{totalWorkTime}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_date = SYSDATE WHERE company_code = #{companyCode} AND user_id = #{userId} AND work_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND in_time IS NOT NULL AND out_time IS NULL

UPDATE tb_attendance SET work_place_type = #{workPlaceType}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_date = SYSDATE WHERE company_code = #{companyCode} AND user_id = #{userId} AND work_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND in_time IS NOT NULL AND out_time IS NULL
